source: <html><head/><body><p>In the box below, specify the URLs to download covers from, with one template URL per line. The following variables are available:</p><p><span style=" font-style:italic;">${title}:</span> Title of the game.<br/><span style=" font-style:italic;">${filetitle}:</span> Name component of the game's filename.<br/><span style=" font-style:italic;">${serial}:</span> Serial of the game.<br/><span style=" font-style:italic;">${crc}:</span> CRC of the game.</p><p><span style=" font-weight:700;">Example:</span> https://www.example-not-a-real-domain.com/covers/${serial}.jpg</p></body></html>
translation: <html><head/><body><p>I rutan nedan anger du de URL:er som omslag ska hämtas från, med en mall-URL per rad. Följande variabler är tillgängliga:</p><p><span style=" font-style:italic;">${title}:</span> Spelets titel.<br/><span style=" font-style:italic;">${filetitle}:</span> Namnkomponenten i spelets filnamn.<br/><span style=" font-style:italic;">${serial}:</span> Spelets serienummer.<br/><span style=" font-style:italic;">${crc}:</span> Spelets CRC.</p><p><span style=" font-weight:700;">Exempel:</span> https://www.example-not-a-real-domain.com/covers/${serial}.jpg</p></body></html>
